question: How many entities were penalised by the Reserve Bank of India in FY25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**353**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has significantly ramped up its regulatory oversight, leading to the penalization of **353** entities during the financial year **2024-25 (FY25)**.
 
• These penalties were imposed on various regulated entities, including **Public Sector Banks**, **Private Sector Banks**, **Foreign Banks**, **Co-operative Banks**, and **Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)** for non-compliance with regulatory guidelines.
 
• The total monetary penalty collected by the central bank during this period amounted to approximately **₹124.63 crore**, reflecting a rigorous stance on maintaining financial discipline.
